## Result

Describe the concrete behavior or content change and why it is useful.

## Verification

List checks actually run and their results. Include the affected world/station, browser or character evidence when relevant. State any untested target or known limitation.

## Compatibility

Explain changes to schemas, stable IDs, routine meaning, saved state or owner-locked decisions. Write "No contract/state change" when applicable.

## Assets and privacy

Identify new asset provenance and license obligations. Confirm the diff contains no private worlds, personal saves, tokens, transcripts or call audio.
